header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: XR Product & Platform Lead | Spatial Computing & Developer Enablement

body: I am applying for the Product Manager, Enterprise Platform and Ecosystem for XR role. For the last several years I have founded and owned the full lifecycle of a software-only XR platform built on a license-to-operator ecosystem model, the same platform-and-ecosystem thinking this role calls for, applied directly to spatial computing.

Much of my work maps to what you are building. I stood up XR product and development functions from scratch at ELIXR, owning discovery through delivery with risk and dependency tracking and direct coordination with engineering and design. In one City of Calgary program I defined and shipped four XR prototypes including a smart-glasses field reporting simulator, and across my platform I architected a multiplayer XR runtime, integrated APIs and generative AI tooling into production pipelines, and negotiated partner integration and licensing structures with hardware-owning operators. The flagship pilot ran at Telus World of Science (603 guests, 73.5% utilization, 4.84/5 satisfaction, NPS 84.3) and the experience is distributed across a 400+ location arcade network in North America and the EU.

What draws me to Google XR specifically is the convergence of AI and XR across lightweight glasses and headsets, and the chance to make that portfolio secure, manageable, and genuinely productive for enterprises. I am comfortable translating business, OEM, and partner needs into PRDs and technical specs, coordinating across platform and security teams, and driving developer-facing APIs and tooling through delivery. I would welcome the chance to do that work on Android XR.
